The complete Intel label and paragraph name Rio Rancho Fab 9 and Fab 11x jointly as an operational mass-production 3D advanced-packaging site and describe co-located high-volume packaging. Accept only that aggregate source-reported operational state by the source day. No exact start, lower bound, per-fab allocation, full ramp or completion of all PMT modernization work is established. The surrounding grant/trainee figures are not production capacity. The page itself ends mid-description of another company with an ellipsis; it is not the complete original thirteen-company release. The complete Intel paragraph has its own closing tag and is followed by other company entries. The footer reserves State rights; About identifies the portal operator but grants no license. Generic homepage canonical/OpenGraph metadata do not identify the article: the exact HTTP request and visible title/date do. This state-publisher report is not an independently measured factory audit, and possible company-supplied wording is not treated as an independent source family of physical observations.
